preconditions.description: Attacker must have 'authorized' privileges, typically assigned to the contract owner.

exploit_hint: The attacker, using their authorized role, calls the `setSellTxLimitInPercent` function with an argument of 0. This action sets the `_maxSellTxAmount` state variable to zero. Consequently, any non-exempt user attempting to sell tokens will have their transaction reverted by the `checkTxLimit` function, effectively trapping their funds in the contract.
